description: When the burst ends exactly at the predicted end time, the tie counts as VDCD-determined: LBT_WAIT_TIMER gets lbt_wait_vdcd_ms at once, with no csma.vdcd_end.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047); its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, U_PDU "hello", no confirmation) is data queued for transmission and produces no SIS output (A-0095, K-0096). Every received D_PDU is a single-segment NON-ARQ-DATA (type 7, address size 4, C_PDU ID as stated, reception window 20) whose segment is a DATA C_PDU holding a DATA S_PDU from SAP 9 to SAP 9 with U_PDU "hi". At 2000: a D_PDU from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.9 (C_PDU ID 1) with EOT 4, end 4000. The burst ends at 4000: both have cleared, the prediction is not in the future so no csma.vdcd_end runs, and the tie counts as VDCD (K-0073), so rule 3 gives 3000 ms. Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050).
